listings.name: RankMaster AI
listings.seo_title: RankMaster AI | SEO Content Brief Generator
listings.meta_description: Build focused SEO briefs, content outlines, title ideas and meta descriptions for your audience. A practical local-first SEO planning assistant.
listings.hero: Turn a topic into a focused content plan.
listings.problem: Writers often start drafting before they understand the reader's intent, page purpose, or evidence needed to make the content useful.
listings.solution: Organize a topic, audience, and primary phrase into a structured brief with an outline, metadata suggestions, and an editorial checklist.
faq: Does it provide live keyword volume?
No. The local edition does not query a live search provider or invent volume figures.
Does it guarantee rankings?
No. Rankings depend on competition, site quality, intent, links, and many external factors.
Can it support Arabic?
It accepts Unicode text; native-language review is needed for wording and intent.
listings.cta: Build a clearer SEO brief before you write.

listings.name: LeadScout Bot
listings.meta_description: Organize company prospects, remove duplicates and score record completeness with source URLs. A transparent B2B lead research workflow.
listings.hero: Make your prospect list more useful and auditable.
listings.problem: Raw prospect lists are often duplicated, incomplete, and disconnected from the source that supports each company record.
listings.solution: Normalize supplied company records, validate source URLs, remove duplicates, and score record completeness with an explicit explanation.
faq: Does it scrape personal profiles?
No. The local workflow processes company-level records supplied by the user.
Does a high score mean the lead will buy?
No. The score measures record completeness, not buying intent or verified fit.
Does it verify emails?
No. Email discovery and verification are not included in this edition.
listings.cta: Start with cleaner, source-backed company data.

listings.name: TradeTrend Analyst
listings.meta_description: Analyze supplied price history with return, average and volatility statistics, then frame bull, base and bear scenarios without live trading.
listings.hero: Turn price history into a transparent research brief.
listings.problem: Market commentary can blur measured observations, assumptions, and predictions, making it difficult to see what data supports.
listings.solution: Calculate descriptive statistics from supplied closing prices and separate observed metrics from scenario hypotheses.
faq: Does it connect to an exchange?
No. This baseline analyzes price data that you provide.
Does it tell me what to buy?
No. It provides descriptive analysis, not investment advice or trade signals.
Can it place trades?
No. Live order execution is intentionally excluded.
listings.cta: Separate measured market data from trading assumptions.

listings.name: DocuSense Support
listings.meta_description: Search supplied document passages and retrieve relevant evidence with document and page references. Designed for transparent support workflows.
listings.hero: Find the passage before you write the answer.
listings.problem: Support and operations teams waste time searching long documents and risk answering from memory instead of the source.
listings.solution: Rank supplied document passages by visible term overlap and return matching excerpts with document and page metadata.
faq: Is this semantic RAG?
Not in the local baseline. It uses transparent lexical retrieval.
Does it extract text from PDFs?
The current runtime accepts extracted text and page metadata; PDF parsing and OCR are not included.
Can it answer without evidence?
It reports insufficient evidence when no relevant passage is found.
listings.cta: Keep document answers tied to visible evidence.

listings.name: SocialSync AI
listings.seo_title: SocialSync AI | Social Content Draft Planner
listings.meta_description: Create channel-aware social post drafts with brand voice notes and an approval checklist. Keep publishing under human control.
listings.hero: Plan the message. Review the draft. Keep control.
listings.problem: Teams rewrite the same idea for multiple channels and lose consistency when review and approval are informal.
listings.solution: Prepare channel-specific draft copy, record the requested brand voice, and supply a human review checklist.
faq: Does it publish to accounts?
No. It creates drafts only; publishing and scheduling are not connected.
Does it guarantee engagement?
No. Reach and engagement depend on audience, creative quality, timing, and platform factors.
Can I add channels?
The workflow accepts channel names; each channel needs editorial and format review.
listings.cta: Create a reviewable social content pack.

listings.name: MailForge Pro
listings.seo_title: MailForge Pro | B2B Cold Email Sequence Writer
listings.meta_description: Draft a three-touch B2B outreach sequence using supplied company context and evidence. Review compliance before sending anything.
listings.hero: Make outreach relevant without inventing familiarity.
listings.problem: Generic outreach sounds interchangeable, while unsupported personalization can damage trust and create compliance risk.
listings.solution: Draft a three-touch sequence from the value proposition and evidence supplied, while flagging missing research and review steps.
faq: Does it send emails?
No. It generates drafts only and never sends messages.
Does it guarantee deliverability?
No. Inbox placement depends on sender reputation, authentication, list quality, and recipient behavior.
Does it find personal contact details?
No. Supply lawful business context and verify outreach requirements.
listings.cta: Write a more relevant first message, then review it.

listings.name: ContentFlip AI
listings.seo_title: ContentFlip AI | Transcript to Article Converter
listings.meta_description: Turn an authorized transcript into an editable article outline with source traceability and editorial checks. No media scraping required.
listings.hero: Turn spoken ideas into an editable written draft.
listings.problem: Useful insights in recordings are difficult to reuse when the transcript is unstructured and source context gets lost.
listings.solution: Organize supplied transcript text into an article structure and preserve basic source details for editorial review.
faq: Does it transcribe audio or video?
Not in the local baseline. It transforms a transcript that you provide.
Does it download videos?
No. Use only media you are authorized to access and process.
Can the article publish without review?
Review quotations, facts, names, and permissions before publishing.
listings.cta: Repurpose a transcript into a first article draft.

listings.name: EstateGuard AI
listings.seo_title: EstateGuard AI | Contract Clause Review Assistant
listings.meta_description: Flag common contract clause references and capture source excerpts for human review. A document triage aid, not legal advice.
listings.hero: Spot clauses that deserve a closer human review.
listings.problem: Important contract terms can be buried in long documents, making first-pass review slow and inconsistent.
listings.solution: Identify common clause keywords, capture source line excerpts, and suggest focused questions for a qualified reviewer.
faq: Is it a legal adviser?
No. It provides document triage only and does not give legal advice.
Does it determine enforceability?
No. Enforceability depends on the full contract and applicable jurisdiction.
Does it read scanned PDFs?
The current runtime accepts extracted contract text; OCR is not included.
listings.cta: Prepare a more focused first-pass contract review.

listings.name: CodeSentinel
listings.meta_description: Inspect added diff lines for common secret, eval, shell and SQL risks. Get review guidance without executing untrusted repository code.
listings.hero: Review risky changes before they reach the main branch.
listings.problem: Small code changes can introduce exposed credentials or unsafe execution paths that are easy to overlook in a large diff.
listings.solution: Scan added diff lines for a bounded set of risky patterns and return candidate findings with line references and remediation prompts.
faq: Does it execute code?
Never. Untrusted source code is not executed.
Does it find every vulnerability?
No. Pattern checks are incomplete and require language-aware tools and human review.
Can it modify files?
No. It reports findings and suggestions only.
listings.cta: Add a fast, explainable review pass to your code changes.

listings.name: MarketMind AI
listings.meta_description: Structure competitor positioning, pricing inputs and evidence gaps into a market intelligence brief with SWOT research prompts.
listings.hero: Turn scattered competitor notes into a decision brief.
listings.problem: Competitor research often mixes dated facts, unverified assumptions, and incomplete pricing into one unreliable summary.
listings.solution: Organize supplied competitor records into a comparison matrix, highlight missing source evidence, and structure next-step research.
faq: Does it browse automatically?
Not in the local baseline. It structures information and source links you provide.
Are competitor prices verified?
No. Verify prices and plan details against dated primary sources.
Does it calculate TAM or market share?
No. Market sizing and share estimates require separate evidence-backed analysis.
listings.cta: Build a competitor brief with visible evidence gaps.
